issue.title: [system-i18n 04/05] Author complete Czech and English catalogs for all system modules (#146)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #357

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed branch `bb/relay-146-system-i18n-04-05-author-complete-czec-thr_kjm8riavfq` to origin.

## Summary

Implements issue #146: complete Czech and English i18n catalogs for all system modules.

- Added/extended `i18n/cs.json` + `i18n/en.json` beside every system module manifest: `chokePoint` (schemaCore), `views`, `seed` (systemDatabases, extended from Tasks-only to all 10 databases), `library`, `mail` (mailSync), `inbox` (inboxPipeline).
- Every `database.<db>.name`, `property.<db>.<property>.name`, `property.<db>.<property>.option.<option>`, `viewType.<type>.name`, and `agentTool.<tool>.label` key each module owns now has both locales.
- Pre-existing Czech labels (the Tasks catalog from #236) preserved verbatim — verified with a byte-for-byte diff against the pre-change file (0 mismatches across 13 keys).
- Wired the 5 new `i18n/` directories into `@semprec/data`'s build script so they ship in `dist/`.
- Added `systemI18nCatalogCoverage.test.ts`: seeds the full system schema, loads every module's catalogs through `ModuleRegistry`, and enumerates every database/property/option/view-type/agent-tool key from the actual seeded state, failing if either locale is missing an entry. This caught one real gap (`property.people.emails.name`, a property the mail module's seed inserts directly onto the `people` database), which is now fixed.
- Updated `systemDatabasesCatalog.unit.test.ts`, which had asserted `database.areas.name` was *not yet* covered (documenting #146's gap) — now asserts it resolves correctly.

Verified in this session: `test:unit` (127 tests), `test:integration` (791 tests), `test:e2e` (5 tests), `lint`, `check:boundaries`, and a full monorepo build — all pass.
